info.title: Quiz API
info.description: Quiz API for accounts, rooms, room roles, assignments, questions, and answers. Each endpoint explains its behavior and current access rules. Global ROLE_ADMIN is separate from room roles such as OWNER, ADMIN, and STUDENT. Sign in or sign up, then paste the returned JWT into Authorize. Start an assignment attempt before submitting answers; configured exam durations apply from the attempt startDate. Paged endpoints accept page (zero-based), size, and sort.

put.description:
Deletes the current user answer for questionId and saves the replacement. Send a JSON boolean, for example true. Returns questionId and answer. Uses the same attempt and exam timer as submission.

**Who can access:** Authenticated users with their own existing AssignmentAnswer attempt for assignmentId. If examDurationMinutes is set, the attempt must not have expired.

**Who can access:** Authenticated users with global ROLE_ADMIN who also hold the OWNER role in this room.

post.summary: Add a student to a room
post.description:
Finds an existing user by userName and assigns the STUDENT room role. Returns a success message. The service only adds the user when its permission check passes.

**Who can access:** Authenticated users with the global ROLE_ADMIN role, or room members whose room role has canAddUser=true.

Creates an account with a hashed password, signs it in, and returns user details and a JWT. Duplicate username or email returns 400.

**Who can access:** Public; no authentication required.

post.summary: Sign in with email or username
post.description:
Authenticates emailOrUsername and password and returns user details and a JWT. Use the returned token in Swagger Authorize. Invalid credentials return 400; a UsernameNotFoundException returns 404.

**Who can access:** Public; no authentication required.
